verses.text: A song for going up to worship. I look up to you, you who sit on your throne in heaven.
As servants watch their master's hand, and as a servant girl watches her mistress's hand, so our eyes look to the LORD our God until he is kind to us.
Be kind to us, LORD, be kind to us, because we have had more than enough insults.
We have had more than enough of the mocking of comfortable people and the insults of proud people.
